text:
Nina C.: hi @people-ops — quick heads up. my manager flagged performance concerns in last week's 1:1 and suggested reallocating some project tasks. i want to request a temporary role adjustment while we do a performance improvement plan and also request ergonomic/time flexibility due to chronic fatigue. would like this documented as an accommodation while we run the performance process.
Sam T.: thanks for sharing, Nina. reassigning tasks could be fine short term. we should loop People Ops so everything is documented and support is provided. i can do an interim task split.
Carla (People Ops): hi Nina — thanks for flagging. we handle performance-related accommodations via a coordinated process so your rights are protected and managers have clarity. steps: please complete the confidential accommodations form or DM me a brief note; we will open a case and coordinate with your manager. we also document temporary role/assignment changes and set review checkpoints.
Nina C.: uploaded a redacted note and DM'd Carla. i included functional limitations (fatigue, difficulty sustaining 4+ hour deep-focus blocks) and suggested 3x 90min deep-work blocks instead.
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2028-330 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
Carla (People Ops): thanks. summary of options we can consider while performance coaching occurs:
```
- temporary task reallocation for 30-90 days (manager documents retained scope)
- temporary remote or hybrid schedule for recovery days
- shorter meeting windows and protected deep-work blocks
- reasonable workload reduction (time-limited)
- check-ins every 2 weeks with People Ops and manager
```
Legal Counsel: adding a quick note: ensure any documentation we maintain is factual and non-discriminatory, tie task changes to business needs and clear timeboxes, avoid language that suggests permanent change without consent. we'll review the accommodation letter if needed.
Sam T.: i can take ownership of the highest-priority components for 6 weeks and we can revisit. i'll update the project board and add a note that this is temporary covered-by-accommodation.
Nina C.: appreciate that, Sam. also requesting an ergonomic chair and permission to take short rest breaks during long sprints. posted a link to recommended chair on the form.
Carla (People Ops): we can approve ergonomic equipment up to the standard allowance; submit receipts to benefits once purchased or we can order via Facilities. regarding rest breaks, we'll document as part of AC-2028-330: "permits short, unscheduled rest breaks up to 10 mins as needed during workday" with 30-day check-in.
peopleops-bot: AC-2028-330 status changed: intake -> documented.
Nina C.: thanks. curious if the performance coaching can pause while accommodation is in place? want to avoid escalation while i stabilize.
Carla (People Ops): we typically continue performance coaching but adjust expectations and timelines to reflect reasonable accommodations. we'll coordinate with manager to avoid punitive actions for disability-related performance gaps and align on updated metrics. i'll set a coordination meeting with you and the manager tomorrow.
Legal Counsel: we'll support language for updated performance goals and ensure process fairness. please keep People Ops in the loop before any formal PIP notices.
Sam T.: meeting invite sent for tomorrow 10:00am PT. cc Carla and Legal.
Nina C.: attending, thank you everyone for handling this carefully. appreciate the support. :heart:
